levels.name: PC Assembly
levels.doneText: All parts installed! Check your results.
levels.sessionName: PC Assembly (CPU, RAM, GPU, PSU, HDD, SSD)

parts.name: CPU
parts.place: Move the CPU over the large square CPU socket in the middle of the board, then release to place it.

wrong.dimm: That is a memory (DIMM) slot. The CPU goes in the large square CPU socket.
wrong.pcie16: That is a long PCIe x16 slot. The CPU goes in the large square CPU socket.
wrong.pciesmall: That is a short PCIe slot. The CPU goes in the large square CPU socket.
wrong.sata: That is a SATA port. The CPU goes in the large square CPU socket.
wrong.atx24: That is the 24-pin power connector. The CPU goes in the large square CPU socket.

parts.name: RAM module
parts.place: Move the RAM over a DIMM slot (the row of long slots), then release to seat it.

wrong.pcie16: That is a long PCIe x16 slot. RAM goes in a DIMM slot.
wrong.pciesmall: That is a short PCIe slot. RAM goes in a DIMM slot.
wrong.cpu: That is the CPU socket. RAM goes in a DIMM slot.
wrong.sata: That is a SATA port. RAM goes in a DIMM slot.
wrong.atx24: That is the 24-pin power connector. RAM goes in a DIMM slot.

parts.name: Graphics card (GPU)
parts.place: Move the GPU over the long PCIe x16 slot, then release to seat it.

wrong.dimm: That is a memory (DIMM) slot. The GPU needs a long PCIe x16 slot.
wrong.pciesmall: That is a short PCIe slot. The GPU needs a long PCIe x16 slot.
wrong.cpu: That is the CPU socket. The GPU needs a long PCIe x16 slot.
wrong.sata: That is a SATA port. The GPU needs a long PCIe x16 slot.
wrong.atx24: That is the 24-pin power connector. The GPU needs a long PCIe x16 slot.

parts.name: PSU 24-pin power cable
parts.place: Drag the 24-pin plug to the long power connector on the right edge of the motherboard, then release to plug it in.

wrong.dimm: That is a memory (DIMM) slot. The 24-pin plug goes in the long power connector on the right edge of the board.
wrong.pcie16: That is a long PCIe x16 slot. The 24-pin plug goes in the long power connector on the right edge of the board.
wrong.pciesmall: That is a short PCIe slot. The 24-pin plug goes in the long power connector on the right edge of the board.
wrong.cpu: That is the CPU socket. The 24-pin plug goes in the long power connector on the right edge of the board.
wrong.sata: That is a SATA port. The 24-pin plug goes in the long power connector on the right edge of the board.

parts.name: HDD SATA cable
parts.place: Drag the cable plug to one of the blue SATA ports on the motherboard, then release to plug it in.

wrong.dimm: That is a memory (DIMM) slot. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.
wrong.pcie16: That is a long PCIe x16 slot. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.
wrong.pciesmall: That is a short PCIe slot. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.
wrong.cpu: That is the CPU socket. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.
wrong.atx24: That is the 24-pin power connector. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.

parts.name: SSD SATA cable
parts.place: Drag the cable plug to a free blue SATA port on the motherboard, then release to plug it in.

wrong.dimm: That is a memory (DIMM) slot. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.
wrong.pcie16: That is a long PCIe x16 slot. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.
wrong.pciesmall: That is a short PCIe slot. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.
wrong.cpu: That is the CPU socket. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.
wrong.atx24: That is the 24-pin power connector. The SATA plug goes in a blue SATA port.

levels.name: Connecting Peripherals
levels.doneText: Everything is connected and powered ON! Check your results.

parts.name: VGA cable (blue plug)
parts.place: Drag the blue VGA plug to the VGA port on the back of the PC, then release to plug it in.

wrong.usb: That is a USB port. The blue VGA plug goes in the blue VGA port.
wrong.hdmi: That is an HDMI port. The blue VGA plug goes in the blue VGA port.
wrong.dvi: That is a DVI port. The blue VGA plug goes in the blue VGA port.
wrong.lan: That is a network (LAN) port. The blue VGA plug goes in the blue VGA port.
wrong.audio: That is an audio jack. The blue VGA plug goes in the blue VGA port.
wrong.inlet: That is the PC power inlet. The blue VGA plug goes in the blue VGA port.
wrong.outlet: That is an AVR outlet. The blue VGA plug goes in the blue VGA port.
wrong.wall: That is the wall socket. The blue VGA plug goes in the blue VGA port.
wrong.switch: That is the AVR power switch. The blue VGA plug goes in the blue VGA port.

wrong.switch: That is the AVR power switch. The HDMI plug goes in the HDMI port.
